snippet.title: Nacho Chihuahua: The Movie: The Game - now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Nacho Chihuahua: The Movie: The Game is now available on Steam!

Join Nacho on a wild adventure as he pursues his true destiny:
to return to his homeland...
South of the Border!

Relive all your favorite scenes while you...
-Explore huge 3D worlds!
-Evade dangerous enemies!
-Escape tricky mazes!

Featuring...
-Seven levels based on all your favorite scenes
-Remastered songs from the film soundtrack
-Animated cutscenes
-15 Steam Achievements
-Full controller support
-A secret alternate ending


Get it at NachoChihuahua.com
